items.title: South Korea picks solar, battery and EVs as key sectors in US$747 billion Green Industrial Plan
items.summary: 原始 RSS 摘录（未翻译）：South Korea’s Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment (MCEE) has unveiled its KRW1,000 trillion (US$747 billion) Korean Green Transformation (K-GX) industrial strategy.
